phases.name: Semantic Support Proof
phases.objective: Prove or withhold paragraph-by-provision support relationships without inferring applicability.
required_outputs: PHASE-B semantic proof queue and closeout evidence
acceptance: No DERIVED/TEXTUAL relation lacks a VERIFIED semantic proof
Unresolved support remains CONTEXTUAL or unresolved
Exact source locator and paragraph/provision identity pass CI
No legal applicability claim inferred from support relation

phases.name: Legal Applicability Resolver
phases.objective: Resolve system-specific legal applicability independently from citation relevance/support.
required_outputs: deterministic resolver rules for non-disputed facts
acceptance: Every result records facts, legal state, time and reasoning path

phases.name: Regulatory Drift and Temporal Legal State
phases.objective: Detect and govern changes in external legal sources while preserving historical state.
acceptance: Historic and current legal state remain distinct
Source failure does not become legal-state change
Drift events are attributable and append-oriented
